name: LethAL R134 Filter Probe
brief: R134: does SetFilter on an Integer field raise when an OR-alternative is not a valid integer?
description: Throwaway probe, not for production use. Measures whether Record.SetFilter/Count raises a runtime error when an Integer field's filter text carries a non-numeric OR-alternative, the exact shape R134 arm D's hash decoy needs (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-12-r134-filter-literal-design.md section 2.7: 'Entry No.' filtered with '<%1|FLT-NONE').
